title: Review result
description: What a reviewing model returns. The driver wraps it into an envelope, which is then held to the same semantic rules as any other envelope: every claim points at evidence that exists, a negative-path claim needs an executed probe, and a PASS may not carry an open blocking finding. A reviewer that breaks one of those gets its result rejected and exactly one retry.

evidence.description: Every probe actually executed. A claim with no logged probe is an assertion, not a finding.
